lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged posterior to the gill slits, with a primary concentration of five columns visible along the mid-flank transition zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal alignment of the circular blobs, forming a discernible grid-like structure across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal feature extends from the posterior gill margin toward the caudal region, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher pixel values on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadowed lower values on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately four to five low-intensity circular clusters are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily located near the posterior margin and base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single elongated, high-luminance object (commensal remora) is attached to the trailing edge of the visible left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin displays a dense distribution of small-scale, high-luminance punctate marks distinct from the larger patterns on the primary flank.
